public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline, and the search did not establish a decisive collapse event. Reuters documents credit-market concern. The reported CMBS sample remained current, but it covers only part of the market and cannot disprove eventual collapse. Neither source settles inevitability or the proposed causal mechanism.
limitations: Absence of a qualifying event in the sources found is not proof that no defaults occurred.
The CMBS sample is broader than AI-specific projects in some respects and narrower than the entire financing market.
No deadline can fairly be inferred.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The collapse of AI data center debt projects is inevitable because their ongoing payments come from customer revenue that, in the vast majority of cases, is entirely theoretical or contingent on payments from unprofitable and unsustainable AI companies.
conditions: in the vast majority of cases

statement.excerpt: Their collapse is inevitable because their ongoing payments are made out of customer revenue that is, in the vast majority of cases, entirely theoretical or contingent on payments from unprofitable and unsustainable AI companies.

from_speaker: ongoing payments are made out of customer revenue
in the vast majority of cases
entirely theoretical or contingent on payments from unprofitable and unsustainable AI companies
our_interpretation: Their refers to the AI data center projects and associated debt described immediately before the sentence.
Collapse means widespread inability to service debt, resulting in defaults, insolvencies or distressed restructurings; a bond-price decline alone does not qualify.
The phrase in the vast majority of cases qualifies the asserted revenue dependence. It is not an if-condition that makes the collapse forecast conditional.
No deadline is supplied. The assessment cannot impose one.
The claimed revenue mechanism must be distinguished from other causes of financial distress.
criteria.support_condition: A broad collapse of the described project-debt population occurs, and records connect it materially to the customer-revenue dependence asserted in the claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The relevant project-debt population reaches final repayment without the predicted broad collapse, or other definitive evidence establishes that collapse is not inevitable. Continued operation for a limited period is insufficient.

evidence.explanation: The report describes current loans in a sample of 19 data-center CMBS transactions despite wider spreads. This sample is not the full AI project-debt population, and current payments cannot refute an undated forecast.
Reuters reports rising concern about credit risk. Such market signals do not establish realized project defaults or an inevitable sector-wide collapse.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Representative records of widespread defaults, insolvencies or distressed restructurings tied to failed customer payments, or definitive repayment records ruling out collapse for the relevant debt population.
